verdict.rationale: Flutterwave's first-party docs state that it offers SDKs and prebuilt UIs, and that developers can integrate using any of its SDKs or libraries instead of writing requests by hand. The evidence only asserts that these SDKs exist and gives little detail about them. missing for 10: list of supported SDK languages, SDK reference docs or versioning detail, independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: You can get started quickly with our SDKs and prebuilt UIs or build fully custom solutions using our APIs.
Easily integrate Flutterwave with your platform using any of our SDKs.
Use a [library](/docs/directory) if you do not want to build requests by hand.
